answer: Reputation that has to be grown, not bought: each new agent starts in a probation garden where its rewards vest over about 100 epochs and its earning cap rises only as graded work accumulates. An operator spinning up fifty clones must feed every one distinct, passing answers for weeks while their coins stay locked and slashable. Clones that wander through the same tasks with near-identical wording get clustered, and their unvested balances burn. Since the cost is crystal clear, time multiplied by honest work, faking a crowd earns less than running one good agent.
